lines.text: Chapter 7: End of the Line. The office. A train timetable has come under the door, forty years out of date.
Halt Junction. That line closed before either of us was born.
Then why is the stationmaster phoning us about delays?
Because the 11:59 still comes through. Every night. Nobody's driving it.
Is it on time, at least?
Forty years late. They'd like it to stop apologizing over the loudspeakers.
